study: D3: momentum residual in the explicit heat exterior and a Gaussian toy
units: dimensionless; viscosity one unless explicitly changed

heat_exterior.interpretation: normalized Eq. (4.29) family on positive radius; matching boundary and full-profile parameters not constructed

scope.pressure_normalization: p approaches zero at radial infinity
scope.residual_sign: partial_t u + (u dot grad)u - viscosity*Laplacian(u) + grad(p)
scope.coordinate_note: xi=r^2/(2*tau) for midplane markers; the paper's s=r^2/2 is distinct from the D2 time ratio
scope.normalized_metric: abs(component residual) / sum(abs(component terms)); inactive all-zero components recorded as zero
scope.absolute_norms: pointwise Euclidean force and Gaussian L2 force over 0<r<8a, |z|<8b
scope.no_proof_claim: finite quadrature and pointwise checks do not prove smooth extension of a full force
